mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.user_id, c.character_name, c.player_name, c.race, c.subclass, c.faction, c.avatar_url, c.initial_classes_string, c.initial_gold, c.initial_downtime, c.current_classes_string, c.current_gold, c.current_downtime, c.current_magic_items, c.soul_coins, c.created_at AS c_created_at, c.updated_at AS c_updated_at FROM "character" c ORDER BY c.created_at ASC

SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.user_id, c.character_name, c.player_name, c.race, c.subclass, c.faction, c.avatar_url, c.initial_classes_string, c.initial_gold, c.initial_downtime, c.current_classes_string, c.current_gold, c.current_downtime, c.current_magic_items, c.soul_coins, c.created_at AS c_created_at, c.updated_at AS c_updated_at FROM "character" c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId}::uuid ORDER BY c.created_at ASC

SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.user_id, c.character_name, c.player_name, c.race, c.subclass, c.faction, c.avatar_url, c.initial_classes_string, c.initial_gold, c.initial_downtime, c.current_classes_string, c.current_gold, c.current_downtime, c.current_magic_items, c.soul_coins, c.created_at AS c_created_at, c.updated_at AS c_updated_at FROM "character" c WHERE c.id = #{id}::uuid

SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.user_id, c.character_name, c.player_name, c.race, c.subclass, c.faction, c.avatar_url, c.initial_classes_string, c.initial_gold, c.initial_downtime, c.current_classes_string, c.current_gold, c.current_downtime, c.current_magic_items, c.soul_coins, c.created_at AS c_created_at, c.updated_at AS c_updated_at FROM "character" c WHERE c.id = #{id}::uuid AND c.user_id = #{userId}::uuid
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "character" ( id, user_id, character_name, player_name, race, subclass, faction, avatar_url, initial_classes_string, initial_gold, initial_downtime, current_classes_string, current_gold, current_downtime, current_magic_items, soul_coins, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}::uuid, #{userId}::uuid, #{characterName}, #{playerName}, #{race}, #{subclass}, #{faction}, #{avatarUrl}, #{initialClassesString}, #{initialGold}, #{initialDowntime}, #{currentClassesString}, #{currentGold}, #{currentDowntime}, #{currentMagicItems}, #{soulCoins}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE "character" SET character_name = #{characterName}, player_name = #{playerName}, race = #{race}, subclass = #{subclass}, faction = #{faction}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, initial_classes_string = #{initialClassesString}, initial_gold = #{initialGold}, initial_downtime = #{initialDowntime}, current_classes_string = #{currentClassesString}, current_gold = #{currentGold}, current_downtime = #{currentDowntime}, current_magic_items = #{currentMagicItems}, soul_coins = #{soulCoins}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}::uuid
UPDATE "character" SET current_magic_items = #{currentMagicItems}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}::uuid
